title: Query source encoding
statement: Let $n,j,m$ be natural numbers, and let $y$ and $p$ be bit strings with lengths $n$ and $j$, respectively. Replace each query source index by the bit at that position in the concatenation of $y$, $p$, and $01$, using $0$ when the index is out of range. The resulting bit string is the self-delimiting pairing of $y$ with the string consisting of $m-j$ copies of $1$, followed by $0$, followed by $p$.
hypotheses_covered: $y$ is a bit string of length $n$
$p$ is a bit string of length $j$
